scripts.lemma:check: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='./LemmaAI_ERD/collieAI.sql';if(!fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8').trim()){console.error('ERROR: LemmaAI_ERD/collieAI.sql is empty. Add your PostgreSQL CREATE TABLE statements first.');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.lemma:build: npm run lemma:check && npx --yes @liam-hq/cli erd build --input ./LemmaAI_ERD/collieAI.sql --format postgres --output-dir ./LemmaAI_ERD/dist && node ./LemmaAI_ERD/scripts/apply-liam-light.mjs
scripts.lemma:preview: npm run lemma:build && npm run lemma:serve
